title: 第19章 杀第20章 衙役算个屁
slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: 王大山看着远处，目光冰冷。
很快。
两道人影悠悠地走了出来。
一人手里拎着木弓，另一人提着一把生锈的柴刀。
两人穿得都破破烂烂，朝着王大山的方向，走了过来。
“张三。”
“赵四。”
王大山一眼就认出了这两个人。
他们都是隔壁村里，出了名的地痞无赖。
平日里游手好闲，正事不干，就喜欢在这大青山的外围转悠。
专门干些偷鸡摸狗的勾当。
遇到落单的，或者好欺负的猎户。
他们就会跳出来，强行抢夺别人的猎物。
周围村子里，不少老实巴交的村民都被他们欺负过。
就连原身也被这两个人欺负过，不止一次被抢走猎物。
“这是，来抢食了。”
王大山看着地上三百多斤重的野猪，再看看这俩不速之客。
心里顿时明白了。
平日里抢别人的就算了。
没想到，今天这俩不知死活的东西，竟然把算盘打到头上来了。
想抢他的肉。
这跟虎口夺食没什么区别。
他冷笑了一声，没有说半句废话。
反手从背后的箭筒里，摸出了一支羽箭，架在了胎铁大弓的弓弦上。
对面。
张三和赵四看着这一幕，忍不住暗暗冷笑。
他们原本以为，射出冷箭警告之后。
王大山这个病秧子，肯定会吓得屁滚尿流，扔下猎物就跑。
可是。
当他们看到王大山非但没跑，反而搭弓瞄准他们的时候。
这两人愣了一下。
不过，他们脸上并没有露出半点害怕的神色。
反倒是满脸的嘲讽和不屑。
张三拿手里的砍刀背，随意地敲打着自己的肩膀。
他冲着旁边的赵四挤眉弄眼，语气里满是戏谑。
“你快看。”
“这不是王家大郎，王大山吗，还搭弓对着咱们俩呢。”
“看样子，这是心里不服气啊。”
旁边的赵四吐了一口唾沫在雪地上。
他晃了晃手里的木弓，刚才这一箭就是他放的。
“王大山，你小子识趣的，就赶紧把弓放下，有多远滚多远。”
content_en:
Wang Dashan looked into the distance with cold eyes.
soon.
Two figures walked out leisurely.
One of them was holding a wooden bow, and the other was carrying a rusty hatchet.
Both of them were dressed in tatters and walked towards Wang Dashan.
"Zhang San."
"Zhao Si."
Wang Dashan recognized these two people at a glance.
They are all well-known ruffians from the next village.
On weekdays, he is idle and does not do any serious work. He just likes to wander around the outskirts of Daqingshan.
Specializes in sneaky things.
Encounter a hunter who is alone or easy to bully.
They will jump out and snatch other people's prey by force.
In the surrounding villages, many honest villagers were bullied by them.
Even the original person was bullied by these two people and was robbed of prey more than once.
"Here we are, here to grab some food."
Wang Dashan looked at the wild boar weighing more than three hundred kilograms on the ground, and then at the two uninvited guests.
I suddenly understood.
On weekdays, just rob others.
Unexpectedly, today these two reckless people actually got their plans over their heads.
Want to steal his flesh.
This is no different from snatching food from a tiger's mouth.
He sneered without saying any nonsense.
With his backhand, he took out a feather arrow from the quiver behind his back and placed it on the bowstring of the iron bow.
……
opposite.
Zhang San and Zhao Si looked at this scene and couldn't help but sneered secretly.
They originally thought that after firing a cold arrow as a warning.
Wang Dashan, a sick man like him, would definitely be so scared that he would pee and drop his prey and run away.
But.
When they saw Wang Dashan, instead of running away, he aimed his bow at them.
The two men were stunned for a moment.
However, there was no look of fear on their faces.
Instead, his face was full of ridicule and disdain.
Zhang San took the back of the machete in his hand and hit his shoulder casually.
He winked at Zhao Si next to him, his tone full of teasing.
"Yo."
"Look quickly."
"Isn't this Wang Dashan, the eldest man of the Wang family? He's pointing his bow at both of us."
"It seems that he is not convinced."
…
"Bah,"
Zhao Si next to him spat on the snow.
He shook the wooden bow in his hand. He was the one who fired the arrow just now.
"Wang Dashan, if you know what's going on, put your bow down quickly and roll as far as you want."
